title: CORE-7119 follow-up: FAQ answer bold ("Please note:") on /director-appointment-resignation/ still #595959 — needs FAQs.styles.ts answerText fix, owned by T8
body:
**Parent:** T4 (CORE-7119 — SHARED: bold body text too light) ## Problem T4's acceptance criteria require `/director-appointment-resignation/` to render its bold "Please note:" run at `#313131` (matching live). T4's ownership lane explicitly excludes "the FAQ accordion (T8)" as a hard boundary, so T4 could not make this specific change. ## Evidence Live-rendered HTML on the clone dev server (`https://localhost:3001/director-appointment-resignation/`) shows the page's ONLY bold run is: ```html
...

Please note: All details will be publicly visible...

``` That exact class string is `faqsStyles.answerText` in `src/blocks/FAQs/FAQs.styles.ts:13` — i.e. this bold run is inside an FAQ answer, not the TextContent/BuyServiceCard body-richtext components T4 fixed. T4 fixed the SAME underlying defect in `src/blocks/TextContent/TextContent.styles.ts` (added an `emphasis` key to `richTextShell`, and fixed the `terms` variant's wrong `--text-on-light-base` override) and `src/components/shared/BuyServiceCard/BuyServiceCard.styles.ts` (added the same `emphasis` rule to `body`), verified live at #313131 on id-requirements, whistleblowing, vat-registration, business-telephone, and terms-and-conditions. ## Exactly what to do In `src/blocks/FAQs/FAQs.styles.ts`, line 13 (`answerText`), append the same two-part rule T4 used elsewhere: ```ts answerText: 'max-w-none pt-4 pb-8 text-[22px] leading-[33px] font-normal text-[var(--text-on-light-muted)] [&_p]:mb-4 [&_p:last-child]:mb-0 [&_ul]:ml-4 [&_ol]:ml-4 [&_a]:text-[var(--surface-brand-cyan)] [&_a]:no-underline [&_:is(strong,b)]:text-[var(--text-on-light-strong)] [&_:is(h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6)_:is(strong,b)]:!text-[color:inherit]', ``` This reuses the existing `--text-on-light-strong` CSS variable (`#313131`, already defined in `src/app/(frontend)/globals.css`) — no new variable needed. The heading-exclusion half is a no-op if FAQ answers never contain headings, but keeps the rule consistent/safe if they ever do. ## Verify Reload `https://localhost:3001/director-appointment-resignation/` and confirm `Please note:` renders `#313131` (pixel-sample or DevTools computed style), surrounding paragraph text stays `#595959`, and no other FAQ answer bold (site-wide) regresses in a way that conflicts with T8's FAQ accordion work.
